correctStatements.text: At 15:15 anneliese.vogel reported that employees across Germany could not log in because the SSO page said the assertion was not yet valid.
Rohan found that the identity provider clock was 6 minutes ahead.
pedro-gutierrez-molina said NTP on idp-02 had been disabled during the previous night's patching.
anneliese.vogel said the service desk had received 230 calls since the start.
At 15:31 pedro-gutierrez-molina decided to re-enable NTP and step the clock on idp-02.
At 15:34 pedro-gutierrez-molina corrected the clock on idp-02, which was then within 40 ms.
At 15:39 Rohan saw logins succeed on test accounts.
At 15:47 it-service-desk-lead-emea-and-apac-coverage asked regional offices to clear their browser sessions.
At 15:59 anneliese.vogel saw the login success rate back above 98%.
it-service-desk-lead-emea-and-apac-coverage said employees were locked out for about 40 minutes.
Action item: monitor clock drift on every identity node, owner Rohan.
Action item: add an NTP check to the patching checklist, owner pedro-gutierrez-molina.
